host_name.description: Hostname of this node (must match DNS and /etc/hosts).

cluster_name.description: Name of the cluster; all members must share the same cluster name.

items.description: Fully-qualified hostname or IP of a cluster member.

cluster_members.description: List of all nodes in the cluster. Must include this host.

auto_preload.description: Automatically load keys when starting. Only set if key distribution is secure.

timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for connection and sync operations.

port.description: TCP port csync2 listens on for cluster traffic.

log_dir.description: Directory for csync2 log files. Set to empty string to disable file logging.

syslog_enabled.description: Enable logging to system syslog facility.

name.description: Unique name for this sync group.

include.description: List of paths/patterns to synchronize in this group.

exclude.description: List of paths/patterns to skip during sync.

key_path.description: Path to the shared encryption key file for this group. Must be identical on all hosts.

auto.description: Enable automatic background sync (requires csync2 service with polling).

port.description: Override default port for this group only (0 = use global port).

check_interval.description: Seconds between sync checks (0 = disable periodic checks).

prefer.description: If conflict resolution needed, prefer changes from this host (e.g., 'node2.example.com').

force.description: Force sync even if conflicts or missing keys are detected.

use_rsync.description: Use rsync for file transfer (required for incremental sync and hardlink preservation).

sync_groups.description: List of sync groups (each defines a set of paths + options).
